title: Soul Snack #8: Recognizing Frightened Parts of Your Personality
excerpt: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav shares a powerful meditation for developing emotional awareness by tuning into your physical sensations.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav shares a powerful meditation for developing emotional awareness by tuning into your physical sensations. 

This practice guides you to notice sensations in your energy processing centers – such as the throat, chest, and stomach areas – to help identify if you’re in a frightened part of your personality or a loving one.

This exercise offers a gentle way to build self-awareness, and Gary encourages listeners to journal their experiences for deeper insights. 

If you find yourself feeling impatient or irritated during the slow pace, recognize this as a clue that you may be in a frightened part of your personality.

Let this meditative exercise support your journey toward creating authentic power.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (02:28): How tuning into your physical sensations can reveal if you’re operating from a place of fear or love.
  • (02:42): Focusing on the throat, chest, and stomach areas to increase self-awareness.
  • (04:06): Recognizing impatience as a signal of a frightened part of your personality.

Enjoy this short, impactful exercise, and join Gary in continuing to explore the journey of transforming consciousness and creating authentic power.
